The '''Pan-African Congress of Mathematicians''' ('''PACOM''')  is an international congress of  [[mathematics]], held under the auspices of the [[African Mathematical Union]].

== List of congresses ==
*2022 &ndash; [[Brazzaville]], Republic of Congo
* 2017 &ndash; [[Rabat]], Morocco
* 2013 &ndash; [[Abuja]], Nigeria
* 2009 &ndash; [[Yamoussoukro]], Ivory Coast
* 2004 &ndash; [[Tunis]], Tunisia
* 2000 &ndash; [[Cape Town]], South Africa
* 1995 &ndash; [[Ifrane]], Morocco
* 1991 &ndash; [[Nairobi]], Kenya
* 1986 &ndash; [[Jos]], Nigeria
* 1976 &ndash; [[Rabat]], Morocco
